347:t_10:44.en:
$$万丈$$
「It does. Then let's take care of That Thing ourselves.」

347:t_10:45.en:
$$トッポ$$
「Now you're talking! ...All right, let's give it our all again today!」

347:t_10:47.en:
$$トッポ$$
「...You were fired up, Big Bro $$万丈$$.」

347:t_10:48.en:
$$万丈$$
「I'm particular about my catchphrases, after all.」

348:t_000:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$ＺＯＮＥ$$... A system that extracts $$次元力|lc$$...」

348:t_000:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That thing really jerked us around during the $$再世戦争$$.」

348:t_000:2.en:
$$マオ$$
「But when we repaired spacetime at $$アクシズ$$, the power of the one here on Earth came in handy.」

348:t_000:3.en:
$$桂$$
「So basically it depends on how you use it. It even worked for sealing the immortal $$アサキム$$.」

348:t_000:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Still, it's a shock. To think he's been revived.」

348:t_000:5.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Going by what the $$アークセイバー$$ people said, the power was probably nullified with a $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ Breaker amid the $$メガノイド$$ commotion.」

348:t_000:6.en:
$n
「Let's start by investigating the surrounding area. We might find some clue.」

348:t_000:8.en:
$n
「I plan to wrap this up quickly and challenge $$クロウ$$'s Systema again.」

348:t_000:9.en:
$$カレン$$
「So you two had a match. Who won?」

348:t_000:11.en:
$$宗介$$
「To hold down $n's Jeet Kune Do, so you're more than just a man in debt.」

348:t_000:12.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Not just in debt... I'm a big-time debtor.」

348:t_000:14.en:
$$スザク$$
「$n got you cornered pretty far too, but he lacked a finishing move.」

348:t_000:15.en:
$n
「Three of my four losses were comebacks against me.」

348:t_000:16.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Your Jeet Kune Do isn't bad, but at times I can see hesitation in your split-second decisions.」

348:t_000:17.en:
$$クロウ$$
「When an all-or-nothing match comes, get past the hesitation and believe in your own strength.」

348:t_000:19.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$クロウ$$ seems to think highly of $n.」

348:t_000:20.en:
$$デュオ$$
「That kid seems to have something that stirs up the blood of the Short Straw Alliance.」

348:t_000:22.en:
$$デュオ$$
「So there you have it, chief. Let me introduce our new recruit, $$クルツ$$.」

348:t_000:24.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Knew it. I saw his potential the moment I laid eyes on him.」

348:t_000:25.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Gruff talk, but a caring nature, and a quiet-type partner...」

348:t_000:26.en:
$$クロウ$$
「And on top of that, the voice is really good.」

348:t_000:27.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Right? He's a promising rookie if I ever saw one.」

348:t_000:28.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Glad to have you, $$クルツ$$. I'm expecting a lot from you.」

348:t_000:29.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Hold on! Quit deciding on your own that I'm one of your buddies!」

348:t_000:30.en:
$$宗介$$
「I don't quite get it, but cherish your ties with people. You said that yourself when I transferred to $$陣代高校$$.」

348:t_000:31.en:
$$クルツ$$
「You, man! Do you know whose fault it is that this is happening!?」

348:t_000:34.en:
$$クルツ$$
「D-Damn...! This is going somewhere... seriously bad!」

348:t_000:35.en:
$$マオ$$
「Hang in there, $$クルツ$$. Having comrades is a good thing.」

348:t_000:36.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Shut up! There's no way I'm joining a team like that!」

348:t_000:37.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Heh... I've been down that road myself.」

348:t_000:38.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「But $$デュオ$$ really does have a lot in common with $$クロウ$$, you know.」

348:t_000:39.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Give me a break. I gave up on my short-straw luck long ago, but otherwise we're nothing alike.」

348:t_000:40.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「I think you share the same way of thinking and living, though...」

348:t_000:41.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Heh... Then someday you'll probably end up carrying a huge debt too.」

348:t_000:43.en:
$$カレン$$
「Careful, $$ヒルデ$$. In $$デュオ$$'s case, he might come crying to you.」

348:t_000:44.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「What should I do if that happens...」

348:t_000:46.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「Don't worry, $$デュオ$$. I'd never abandon you.」

348:t_000:48.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Being able to lean on a woman so honestly is a big difference between you and me.」

348:t_000:49.en:
$n
「Not just leaning, but sometimes being leaned on... That's what an equal partner is.」

348:t_000:51.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Then here's a useful saying for you, $n. ...There's the kanji for 'person,' right?」

348:t_000:53.en:
$$クロウ$$
「They say it shows two people leaning on each other for support, but look closely and one of them is putting his full weight on the other.」

348:t_000:54.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That's what humans are like. Men and women especially.」

348:t_000:55.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$$クロウ$$! Don't teach $n indecent things! What do you mean, men and women...!」

348:t_000:56.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...What kind of interpretation is that?」

348:t_000:57.en:
$n
「Once Miss $$スズネ$$ gets like this, there's no stopping her. Please give up.」

348:t_000:58.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Looks like his woman-trouble fate hasn't changed.」

348:t_000:59.en:
$$桂$$
「That's his short-straw luck for you, too.」

348:t_000:61.en:
$$五飛$$
「We didn't come here to play.」

348:t_000:62.en:
$$クロウ$$
「At times like this, I'm grateful for how serious you two are...」

348:t_000:63.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「How is it, $l? You said you wanted to concentrate, so I allowed a solo sortie. Did you find anything?」

348:t_000:64.en:
$n
「Nothing so far... But I still have a feeling of unease.」

348:t_000:65.en:
$$宗介$$
「Is there some connection between $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ and the $$スフィア$$s?」

348:t_000:67.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Nothing on my end in particular...」

348:t_000:68.en:
$$クロウ$$
(Maybe $n is special... There's that power called $$ブーストアップ$$ too...)

348:t_000:70.en:
$n
(Was the unease I've felt since the $$時の牢獄$$ was destroyed unrelated to the $$スフィア$$s...? If so...)

348:t_000:73.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...I'm sorry. Lately I feel anxious a lot less often than I used to.」

kept_omissions: 348:t_000:11: Sousuke's 'you also said that' - subject (Kurz) settled by scene; written explicitly
348:t_000:10-12/348:t_000:5: ZONE-nullifier unnamed in Japanese; rendered passive 'the power was probably nullified'
uncertain: 348:t_000:22 大将 rendered 'chief' (Duo to Crowe); 348:t_000:30 Sousuke's 'you said so' read as Kurz's earlier remark at Jindai; 348:t_000:25 相棒 read as Sousuke, 'quiet-type partner'; 348:t_000:1 ZONE 'jerked us around' (振り回された) ; 348:t_000:2 'the one here on Earth' (地球にある、これ) = Earth's ZONE; 348:t_000:12 高額債務者 = 'big-time debtor'
